subject: STABLE step 5: render_encoder.inc ec48e06b (native indexed attribute draws)
body: drawIndexedPrimitives: attribute-fetching generic shaders now take the native index-buffer path (your n2r gd_request_ok/resources change) when baseVertex==0 and baseInstance==0 (n2r refuses/cannot represent those yet; they keep CPU expansion). q->index = {ib,offset,n*size}; q->vertex = whole bound range from the slot offset (a set*Bytes slot: its own bytes only), >= one stride; planner validates vertex 0 only (planning vertex_count=1 for indexed attribute draws, mirroring n2r; also keeps the plan memo key stable).
